title: Run both gates at triage before a story is queued

story.i_want_to: a triaged story that Gate A or Gate B would refuse to be escalated before it is queued
story.so_that: no unattended implementation is spent on work the merge gate will refuse

rationale: Design section 5 runs both gates twice; only the merge-time run exists. With the dispatch driver on, a story predicted to touch the claims path or contradicting a decision is implemented at roughly USD 10-20 and then refused. Running the same gates over the trio's prediction first turns that spend into an escalation that costs nothing.

acceptance_criteria.description: An accepted story verdict whose lens verdicts fail Gate A takes triaged -> escalated over :triage_escalate, with Gate A's reasons in escalation_reason, and is not queued.
An accepted story verdict whose drafted touches make GateB.evaluate(:triage, ...) return anything other than clear takes triaged -> escalated with Gate B's reasons, and is not queued.
An accepted story verdict that clears both gates is queued exactly as today.
A story verdict without lens_verdicts skips the triage Gate A run, logs gate_a_skipped_no_lens_verdicts, and is otherwise judged by Gate B alone.
A missing or unparseable Gate B trigger configuration escalates the story rather than queuing it.

test_cases.name: disagreeing lenses escalate at triage
preconditions: story at triaged, accepted triage dispatch
steps: apply a story verdict whose lens verdicts disagree
expected_results: stage escalated, edge triage_escalate, agent_status unchanged, no queued row

test_cases.name: predicted claims-path touch escalates
steps: apply a unanimous story verdict with touches [lib/home_care_billing/claims/x.ex]
expected_results: stage escalated naming the Gate B trigger

test_cases.name: clean verdict is queued
steps: apply a unanimous story verdict with harmless touches

test_cases.name: 1.14 verdict skips Gate A only
steps: apply a story verdict without lens_verdicts and harmless touches

test_cases.name: broken trigger config fails closed
expected_results: stage escalated, reason names the config error

technical_notes: Route table: lib/loopctl/delivery/triage_verdict.ex:67 ('story' route); the gates are called inside the same transaction that writes the drafted story
Gate B: Loopctl.DeliveryGates.GateB.evaluate(:triage, input, triggers) already supports the triage phase (gate_b.ex:83)
Touches are kept in draft metadata (triage_verdict.ex:698-707)
non_goals: Does not bind the implementer to the predicted touches; the merge-time run remains the one that gates
Does not add new trigger patterns
